findings.en_sentence: François Therrien and colleagues (2005) questioned earlier interpretations, suggesting Carnotaurus had a bite force twice that of the American alligator.
findings.problem: This sentence has no Spanish counterpart (EN 30 sentences, ES 29), so the Spanish page drops the Therrien 2005 bite-force result.
findings.correct: Add the Spanish version: «François Therrien y sus colegas (2005) cuestionaron esta interpretación y hallaron que la fuerza de mordida de Carnotaurus duplicaba la del aligátor americano.» (placed after the Mazzetta sentence)

findings.en_sentence: François Therrien and colleagues (2005) questioned earlier interpretations, suggesting Carnotaurus had a bite force twice that of the American alligator.
findings.problem: 'Earlier interpretations' points at nothing introduced yet: the interpretation Therrien questioned (Mazzetta et al.'s quick-but-weak bite) comes in the next sentence, so the two read as unrelated, contradictory claims; next to the 3,341/3,392 N figures, 'twice the alligator' also reads as a contradiction with no explanation.
findings.correct: Put it after the Mazzetta sentence: 'This was questioned by François Therrien and colleagues (2005), who found Carnotaurus's bite to be twice as strong as that of the American alligator.'
findings.checked_in: enwiki Paleobiology/feeding (F043 quote 'This interpretation was questioned...'), F077

findings.en_sentence: The species name "sastrei" honors Anselmo Sastre, the owner of the estancia where the first and only specimen was found in Chubut, Argentina.
findings.es_sentence: El nombre de la especie «sastrei» rinde homenaje a Anselmo Sastre, propietario de la estancia donde se encontró el primer y único ejemplar en Chubut, Argentina.
findings.problem: The eswiki source says 'Anselmo Sastre', but the cited enwiki revision (F006) and Bonaparte's description name the ranch owner 'Angel Sastre'; the page picks the less reliable source.
findings.correct: ...honors Angel Sastre, the owner of the ranch where the only specimen was found.
findings.checked_in: F006 (enwiki Discovery) vs F065 (eswiki intro); knowledge

findings.en_sentence: Carnotaurus is the first known theropod dinosaur to have a significant number of fossil skin impressions found on its skeleton.
findings.es_sentence: Carnotaurus es el primer terópodo conocido por el que se han encontrado impresiones fósiles de piel significativas sobre su esqueleto.
findings.problem: 'por el que' is the wrong relative ('del que'), and 'impresiones ... significativas' changes 'a significant number of impressions' into 'significant impressions'.
findings.correct: Carnotaurus fue el primer terópodo descubierto con un número importante de impresiones fósiles de piel.

findings.en_sentence: Carnotaurus was highly adapted for running and was possibly one of the fastest large theropods, reaching speeds of approximately 56 km/h.
findings.es_sentence: Carnotaurus estaba altamente adaptado para correr y pudo ser uno de los terópodos más rápidos, alcanzando velocidades de unos 56 km/h.
findings.problem: The Spanish drops 'large' ('de gran tamaño'), which turns the claim into one of the fastest theropods overall.
findings.correct: ...pudo ser uno de los grandes terópodos más rápidos, con velocidades de unos 56 km/h.
findings.checked_in: F068 (eswiki 'terópodos más rápidos de gran tamaño')

findings.en_sentence: In 2020, Cerroni and colleagues agreed the horns supported keratinous sheaths but argued these sheaths were not much longer than the bony cores.
findings.es_sentence: En 2020, Cerroni y sus colegas coincidieron en que los cuernos soportaban vainas de queratina, pero argumentaron que estas vainas no eran mucho más largas que los núcleos óseos.
findings.problem: 'Agreed' refers to an earlier proposal of horn sheaths that the page never introduces, and the horns themselves (two thick horns above the eyes) are never described anywhere on the page.
findings.correct: Describe the horns first (F009/F019), then: 'The horns probably carried keratinous sheaths; Cerroni and colleagues (2020) argued these were not much longer than the bony cores.'

findings.en_sentence: Carnotaurus had a skull measuring 59.6 cm in length that was proportionally shorter and deeper than any other large carnivorous dinosaur.
findings.es_sentence: Carnotaurus poseía un cráneo de 59,6 cm de longitud, proporcionalmente más corto y profundo que el de cualquier otro gran carnívoro dinosaurio.
findings.problem: 'gran carnívoro dinosaurio' is English word order.
findings.correct: ...que el de cualquier otro gran dinosaurio carnívoro.

findings.en_sentence: Carnotaurus's forearm was only one-quarter the size of its upper arm.
findings.es_sentence: El antebrazo de Carnotaurus solo medía una cuarta parte del tamaño del brazo superior.
findings.problem: 'brazo superior' is a calque of 'upper arm'.
findings.correct: El antebrazo de Carnotaurus solo medía una cuarta parte de la longitud del brazo (húmero).

findings.en_sentence: Researchers suggest the distinctive horns and muscular neck of Carnotaurus may have been used in intraspecific fighting.
findings.es_sentence: Los investigadores sugieren que los cuernos distintivos y el cuello muscular de Carnotaurus pudieron utilizarse en peleas entre individuos de la misma especie.
findings.problem: 'cuello muscular' (the same in the Novas sentence) is a calque; in Spanish a brawny neck is 'musculoso'.
findings.correct: ...los característicos cuernos y el musculoso cuello de Carnotaurus...

findings.en_sentence: Fernando Novas suggested in 2009 that Carnotaurus's short skull and muscular neck were adaptations for delivering quick, strong head blows.
findings.es_sentence: Fernando Novas sugirió en 2009 que el cráneo corto y el cuello muscular de Carnotaurus eran adaptaciones para administrar golpes de cabeza rápidos y fuertes.
findings.problem: 'administrar golpes' is a calque of 'deliver blows', and 'cuello muscular' should be 'musculoso'.
findings.correct: ...el cráneo corto y el cuello musculoso de Carnotaurus eran adaptaciones para asestar cabezazos rápidos y fuertes.

findings.en_sentence: Calculations suggest the caudofemoralis muscle in Carnotaurus had a mass of 111 to 137 kg per leg.
findings.es_sentence: Los cálculos sugieren que el músculo caudofemoralis de Carnotaurus tenía una masa de 111 a 137 kg por pierna.
findings.problem: In Spanish the muscle is the 'músculo caudofemoral' (or 'caudofemoralis longus' in italics as a Latin term).
findings.correct: ...el músculo caudofemoral de Carnotaurus tenía una masa de 111 a 137 kg por pata.

findings.en_sentence: Researchers suggest that the variation in scale size on Carnotaurus may have helped regulate body heat through thermoregulation.
findings.es_sentence: Los investigadores sugieren que la variación en el tamaño de las escamas de Carnotaurus pudo haber ayudado a regular la temperatura corporal mediante la termorregulación.
findings.problem: Says the same thing twice ('regulate body heat through thermoregulation') and leaves out the reason the source gives (large body size, active lifestyle).
findings.correct: ...may have helped it shed excess heat, given its large size and active lifestyle.

findings.en_sentence: Carnotaurus is a member of the group Furileusauria.
findings.es_sentence: Carnotaurus pertenece al grupo superior Furileusauria.
findings.problem: 'grupo superior' is a literal rendering of PBDB's 'parent group' and isn't a Spanish taxonomic term.

findings.en_sentence: Carnotaurus lived in South America during the Late Cretaceous period, approximately 69 to 66 million years ago.
findings.es_sentence: Carnotaurus vivió en Sudamérica durante el periodo del Cretácico Superior, aproximadamente entre 69 y 66 millones de años atrás.
findings.problem: The Cretácico Superior is an epoch, not a 'periodo'; 'millones de años atrás' is unnatural; and the page also says 'Cretácico tardío' elsewhere, so the two terms are inconsistent.
findings.correct: Carnotaurus vivió en Sudamérica durante el Cretácico Superior, hace entre 69 y 66 millones de años.
findings.checked_in: knowledge; ES sentence on Abelisauridae ('Cretácico tardío')

findings.en_sentence: The function of Carnotaurus's horns is debated, with theories ranging from fighting conspecifics or killing prey to display for courtship or species recognition.
findings.es_sentence: La función de los cuernos de Carnotaurus es debatida, con teorías que van desde la lucha con congéneres o la caza de presas hasta el despliegue para el cortejo o el reconocimiento de especies.
findings.problem: This repeats the horn-fighting discussion from the paleobiology section; it reads as the opener of that debate but comes at the very end of the page.
findings.correct: Merge it at the start of the horn-function paragraph, before the fighting hypotheses.
